title: Fabulous gems off the grid!
text: We loved discovering a neighborhood that is totally off the path and one never hears of, as most visitors stay around the city centre. Atair is such a positive guy with great energy and did a fabulous job making us feel welcome and excited like a crew visiting authentic local spots. Each had its own style and yummy tapas. Atair knows well the produce he serves and has a lovely relationship with the owners of every establishment. Loved the vermut ritual!
author: Carla P

title: Great Hidden Barcelona
text: We had a great time with Atair on this walking tour. The food was plentiful and delicious. It was the perfect way to show a grup of foreign friends visiting the city about spanish tapas. He spent extra time explaining the food background and preparation to really understand its origin. We had fabulous drinks and great company. Would highly recommend to get out of the main city and having Atair show you how the real Barcelona people enjoy a casual night out.
author: Tarheelbcn

title: A must do in Barcelona
text: We had an amazing time in this experience! We were able to see a local, authentic area with a guide and enjoyed great food and drinks. It's an experience we would recommend to anyone. Thank you!
author: E2400HPrafaell

title: Highly Recommend
text: This is a can’t miss tour - Altair is fantastic! He was very friendly, informative, flexible, and well-connected to the neighborhood. The food and wine were both incredible and we would never have found the spots he took us to. Highly recommend.
author: Dbax90

title: First night in Barcelona start with great tapas and wine ;)
text: First time in Barcelona, amazing night to visit local bar and tapas and met new friends. Atair did a great job explaining local food and wine!! Highly recommended if you want to have a night out at the local neighborhood.
author: Vc2580

title: 10/10 will be recommending to all of my friends
text: This tour was one of the highlights of the trip! The drinks and food were delicious. The owners of the bars/restaurants that we went to were so kind. The host was very fun!
author: LindsayG1050

title: Wonderful evening
text: This was a terrific tour.  Atair is charming and fun, and speaks fluent idiomatic English.  We chose this tour over some others because it was not in a touristy area, but rather focused on some places in a Barcelona neighborhood (El Clot) which were authentically "local".  The places we visited with Atair were welcoming and friendly (a couple opened up specifically for us), the tapas was delicious, varied and abundant, and the wine very good. author: Phil C

title: The only way to truly get to know Barcelona in a short visit
text:
Atair made our day tour through Barcelona a memorable experience, we walked through every must-see spot plus some "off the beaten path" remarkable gems (including his restaurant picks) that made us feel like true locals. 
I highly recommend it!
author: andreRhubner
